intro.label: Intro
intro.hint: Added at the start of the clip and makes it longer

outro.label: Outro
outro.hint: Added at the end of the clip and makes it longer

insert.label: Full insert
insert.hint: Inserted in the middle and makes the clip longer

broll.label: B-roll
broll.hint: Covers the picture while the audio continues. Length does not change

overlay.label: Overlay
overlay.hint: A small corner over the video. Length does not change

background.label: Background
background.hint: Behind the video for the whole clip

thumbnail.label: Thumbnail
thumbnail.hint: Not placed in the video itself

banner.localCards: The images it creates are graphic cards made on your computer – not images created by an AI model. They exist so you can test inserting images into video without an API key, and they are labeled as such everywhere.
banner.keySafety: The key is stored encrypted on your computer, sent only by the server, and never exposed in the browser.

clip.title: Images in the clip
clip.hint: Images enter the video only on re-export. Intro, outro and insert make the clip longer; B-roll, overlay and background do not change its length.
clip.none: This clip has no images yet.
clip.grows: The clip will be {{seconds}} seconds longer on the next export.
clip.placedBody: Click “Export again” to put it into the video.
clip.modalTitle: Place an image in the clip
clip.noneReady: There are no ready images in this project.
clip.entryHint: Time is measured on the edited clip – exactly what you see in the player.

suggest.title: Visual suggestions
suggest.hint: Transcript analysis finds sentences an image would strengthen. No image is created or placed in the clip unless you click.
suggest.heuristicNote: The suggestions come from the local engine. Enabling a language model in settings gives more precise descriptions.
suggest.placedAt: It will appear at {{time}} on the next export.

page.title: AI images
page.subtitle: Create images for a project and place them in clips – as an intro, B-roll, background or overlay.
page.onTheWay: The new image is on its way.
page.savedTo: Images will be saved to the project “{{project}}” and be available in its clip editor.
page.emptyBody: Write a description above and click “Create image”. Every image you create appears here and can be placed in clips.
page.revisedPrompt: The prompt as the model rewrote it
page.editPromptHint: Editing creates a new image. The existing image is kept unchanged.
page.deleteBody: The image and its file will be deleted, and any placement in clips will be removed. This cannot be undone.
page.openPreview: Open the image at full size
